name: Navigate the ribbon using key tips

elements.name: Select the 3D Model tab with its key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the user presses "M"
the 3D Model ribbon tab is selected
key tips appear on its commands
the user presses Escape
the command key tips remain visible
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear
the part remains active

elements.name: Open a command using a two-letter key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon command key tips are displayed

elements.name: Continue a two-letter key tip after an unmatched letter

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon command key tips are displayed

elements.name: Change ribbon display using key tips and menu navigation

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is fully displayed with "Cycle Through All" selected
the user presses Alt and enters the display control key tip "X2"
the ribbon displays compact panel buttons
the user presses Alt and enters the display menu key tip "X3"
the ribbon display policy menu opens
the user presses Down and Enter
the ribbon displays tabs only
the user reopens the display policy menu with Alt and "X3"
"Minimize to Tabs" is marked as selected
the user presses Down four times and Enter
the user presses Alt and enters "X2"
the full Tools ribbon is visible

elements.name: Continue after an unmatched top-level key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the user presses Alt
top-level key tips appear
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the user presses "Z"
the top-level key tips remain visible
the Tools ribbon remains selected
the user presses "M"
the 3D Model ribbon is selected
its command key tips are displayed
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear

elements.name: Return to tab key tips after a partial command key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the user presses Alt and then "M"
the 3D Model command key tips appear
the user presses "H"
the visible command key tips narrow to H-prefixed entries
the user presses Escape
the tab and quick-access key tips appear
the command key tips are no longer displayed
the user presses "M"
the 3D Model command key tips appear again
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear
the part remains visible

elements.name: Switch ribbon tabs with the mouse while top-level key tips are visible

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the user clicks the Tools ribbon tab
the Tools ribbon is selected and its commands are visible
the key tips disappear
the part remains visible

elements.name: Dismiss top-level key tips after an unmatched letter on View

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full View ribbon is selected
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the user presses "I"
the top-level key tips remain visible
the View ribbon remains selected
the user presses Escape
the key tips disappear
the View ribbon and part remain visible

elements.name: Open the panel selector while top-level key tips are visible

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible
top-level ribbon key tips are visible after pressing Alt

elements.name: Open temporary ribbon commands using a tab key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the user presses "M"
the temporary 3D Model command area opens
command key tips are visible
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear
the temporary 3D Model command area remains visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command area closes and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible

elements.name: Launch a command by key tip from the minimized ribbon

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
the user presses Alt
top-level key tips appear
the user presses "M"
the temporary 3D Model command area opens with command key tips

elements.name: Launch a command through a left-docked compact group key tip

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left
Modify is displayed as a compact group button
the user presses Alt
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls

the user presses Escape

elements.name: Keep ribbon key tips visible while arrow keys change the model view

steps.name: a part with a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is selected
the user presses Alt to show top-level ribbon key tips
the user presses the Right Arrow key
the displayed solid changes orientation
the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible
the user presses the Left Arrow key
the solid returns to its prior visible orientation
the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible
the user presses the 3D Model tab key tip
the ribbon shows command-level key tips
the user presses Alt
the key tips disappear

elements.name: Select a solid face while command key tips are visible

steps.name: a part with a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is selected
the user presses Alt and then the 3D Model tab key tip
command-level ribbon key tips are visible
the user clicks a visible solid face
the ribbon key tips disappear
the clicked face is selected
a contextual mini toolbar appears beside the selected face
the user clicks empty viewport space
the face selection and contextual mini toolbar clear

elements.name: Navigate an expanded model browser while ribbon key tips are visible

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible
an extrusion is expanded in the model browser to show its child sketch
the extrusion is selected in the browser
the user presses Alt to show top-level ribbon key tips
the user presses Down Arrow
the child sketch is selected in the browser
the corresponding sketch geometry is highlighted in the viewport
the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible
the user presses Up Arrow
the extrusion is selected again
the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible
the user presses Alt
the ribbon key tips disappear

elements.name: Keep Tools key tips visible after Escape with a face selected

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with one face selected

elements.name: Dismiss top-level key tips after Escape on Tools without a selection

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is selected
no model face is selected
